# Stage display

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

A full-screen output another screen drives (a projector, a kiosk TV). Chrome-less, unauthenticated, and fed only public frames. Build your own; there is no generator yet.

No generator yet; follow the summary and stamp the file `standards-pattern: ui-page.stage-display`.

Kit: @kit/ui StageNotice.
Checks: none. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- Chrome-less: no shell, navigation or controls.
- Overlays only through kit StageNotice.
- A versioned message protocol with epoch and sequence ordering; stale frames are refused, and a contract test pins the protocol.
- Reduced motion is honoured and tested.
- No input except entering fullscreen.
- Only public frame fields reach it.
- The room is never authenticated: it holds no user session.

Related: `ui-page.kiosk`, `ui-page.live-console`.

Graduates: Graduate to a kit recipe when a second app needs it.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Is it a full set of CRUD screens, a workflow page beyond CRUD, a full-screen display, or a full-screen sub-page?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.stage-display` to see its siblings.
